notes: Web 434 — NAV-SEARCHBOX-LINK (Nov 12, 2026; layers on web 433). The owner's film, Nov 12 11:21–11:22 CST, on web 432: in the Navigator he pastes into the TOP search box ('Search places or an address…') the text 'Hauling To: https://maps.app.goo.gl/8FsunB9m3Rijgymq8?g_st=ic' — the Hauling To short link exactly as it arrives in a dispatch text. The Places panel answers 'No place matches that — try Search as address below.' Underneath, the nav state thrashes: banners flip between the old plan's instructions, 'You have arrived — Aecon Trans' (the PREVIOUS destination) and 'Destination set — Getting your truck route…'; the remaining distance walks 250 → 220 → 180 m while he stands still; the destination pin on the map stays the OLD pin by the airport, not the link's pin (51.1225089,-114.0122197). Two defects, one fix (modules/navigator.js only). (1) LINK IN THE SEARCH BOX: the map search box now reads a link itself (searchBoxPin / mapLinkGo): a pin readable in the pasted text (sentPinCoords — the same read the sheet search has had since v330) lands through the same landSentPin; a pin hidden behind a short link follows through the SAME one link brain (PinLinks.resolveUrl, the v330 plumbing) — exactly one route request, and no Places/geocoder call is ever run on link text. The Places panel never dead-ends a link: for a link in the box it shows '🔗 That is a Maps link — tap Go and I will take you to its pin.' A dead link gets plain words on the banner AND in the sheet results box (the v395 law), never silence. Ordinary place/address text is not consumed and searches exactly as before; the panel's 'Search as address' door carries the same intake. (2) CLEAN DESTINATION HANDOVER: setDest now retires the old route the moment a NEW destination lands — plan, line, steps and the arrival state cleared, the old route's line removed from the map — and arms exactly one auto-route for the new pin. Before, the old plan stood under the new pin: the auto-route refused to fire while any plan stood, so no route to the new pin was ever requested, and every fix repainted the old instructions over the 'Destination set' banner and judged arrival against the old line. While the new route is in flight the banner holds the one honest state; doRoute stamps the destination it answers (routeKey / destMoved) and a landing — or a failure — for a destination the driver has already replaced is dropped, never adopted (the guard also stands at finalizeRoute's door, so the v433 truck screen's delayed landings are covered); a re-route for the SAME destination adopts exactly as before. The destination pin rendered is the resolved link pin; the v432 camera lock and standstill judge are untouched, and a proven standstill still gates guidance while he stands still. UNTOUCHED: Navigate from pin (v430), the truck routing + learning guard (v433 — its suite passes unchanged on these bytes), the PiP strip (v427), the GPS voice (v428), dispatch-notes pins (v429), the Documents page (v431), counting. Bench: the new suite tools/nav-searchbox-link-v434-test.js (59 checks) replays his exact paste through the map search box → resolves to 51.1225089,-114.0122197, exactly one route request, no Places call, no arrival banner from the prior destination; the Go Empty labelled line and a bare link likewise; typed text ('Geocoder Place', 'Aecon') still searches places; the ARRIVED-at-A → paste-B handover is sampled at every step (banner monotone: set → routing → guidance, the old arrival never re-renders, no second route request while he stands still, the countdown holds once the standstill proof stands); a stale in-flight landing for A is dropped and B's route is requested in its place.
